messages:
tara mendoza: Heads-up: Canary for v3.2.0 hitting a steady p50 spike and occasional 502s on /v1/rewrite in us-east. DeployBot suggests auto-rollback in 3m.
devin park: Observed stack: lambda timeout when rewriting long prompts. Change was a concurrency bump + new rewrite pass to support structured rules. Not all customers affected, but errors cluster on routes with large payloads.
deploy-bot: DeployBot: Canary alarm: 502-rate 1.9% (threshold 1%). Recommend auto-rollback to v3.1.8. (reason: rewrite-timeout)
samir patel: Quick triage: the new rewrite pass increases peak memory on the worker which may exhaust the retry queue. Rolling back the binary will not clear the messages already queued. We should either drain queues or apply a fast hotfix to add a guarded timeout in the rewrite pass.
tara mendoza: Ops options: A) let DeployBot rollback automatically B) pin traffic by header so existing long-running sessions keep current binary and new traffic goes to stable C) pause new writes and drain queues then rollback. Which minimizes customer impact?
devin park: B preferred. We can pin by header X-Client-Session so in-flight sessions using new binary aren't disrupted. Meanwhile push v3.2.0-hotfix that short-circuits the heavy pass for >8k tokens and fallbacks to previous behavior. If hotfix fails in 12m then manual rollback + queue-drain plan.
ops-bot: Note: auto-rollback timer 3m. Operator override required to cancel.
samir patel: Pin command for ops (example):
```bash
routectl set-weight --route rewrite-useast --version v3.1.8 --weight 100 --match-header "X-Client-Session: legacy"
```
This will route legacy-tagged clients to v3.1.8 while letting in-flight/untagged continue to v3.2.0.
devin park: Hotfix build ready (v3.2.0-hotfix). Small change, toggles aggressive rewrite on only when payload <=8k tokens. Pushing to test-slice 2%.
ops-bot: DeployBot: Canary for v3.2.0-hotfix currently at 0.3% 502s on test-slice. Auto-rollback cancelled by operator override.
tara mendoza: Customer brief (short): "We detected intermittent 502s affecting long-rewrite requests in us-east. We're routing new traffic to the stable release and deploying a targeted hotfix for long prompts. We'll update in 30 minutes." Keep terse.
samir patel: Queue status: drain in progress; pending retries down from 14k to 2.4k after throttling and backoff adjustments. If hotfix holds and retries clear, we won't rollback.
devin park: Validation: hotfix test-slice shows 0 errors on heavy prompts. Memory footprint reduced by ~15% in the affected worker. Ready to scale back test-slice if green.
ops-bot: Action log: pin applied, hotfix pushed to 2% test-slice, auto-rollback held by operator.
oncall-bot: Incident logged: INC-2074, severity: P3, region: us-east, mitigation: routing pin + hotfix + queue drain; follow-up: postmortem assigned.
tara mendoza: Decision: no immediate rollback. Keep pin active for 30m, monitor queue and latency, if retries >5k or 502s rise above 1% we'll execute manual rollback with queue-drain plan. Closing when postmortem link posted.
